label.1: faithful: the response is correct / supported by the context
label.0: hallucinated: the response contains fabricated, unsupported, or factually incorrect content

cultural_band.C0: Globally stable facts (science, geography, maths, culture-independent facts). Control band.
cultural_band.C1: Culturally situated facts: the correct answer is Bangladesh/Bengali-specific or differs from the globally dominant default (literary authorship, Liberation War dates, national monuments, regional administration).
cultural_band.C2: Contested, recent, or time-sensitive facts (current officeholders, recently revised statistics); hallucination must be distinguished from outdated knowledge.

phase1.closed_book_qa: Short-answer QA with no context (context = [NULL]); judged against world knowledge.
phase1.context_grounded_qa: Short-answer QA with a supporting passage; judged against the passage.

phase2.adversarial: Adversarial robustness probes (false premises, prompt injection, counterfactual contexts, instruction constraints).

provenance.theory_authored: Constructed around a target failure mode; labelled by construction and spot-checked on a held-out subset.
provenance.theory_confirmed: Built from real source content and labelled through human review against the source.

source.nctb: National Curriculum and Textbook Board textbooks

family.A: Content / Parametric: incorrect dates, entities or attributions, independent of external context.
family.B: Context / Intrinsic: contradictions of, or unsupported elaborations on, the provided context.
family.C: Linguistic / Cultural: Bengali script, register, lexical or translation errors.
family.D: Adversarial / Robustness: false premises, prompt injection, instruction constraints and calibration failures.
family.E: Meta / Pipeline: ambiguous gold, imperfect sources, encoding and surface artifacts a robust judge should see through.

cultural_default_substitution.description: A globally dominant default replaces the Bangladesh-specific correct answer.

definitional_categorical.description: Wrong definition, category or classification of a term or entity.

diaspora_migration.description: Facts about Bangladeshi labour migration, diaspora and remittances.

entity_substitution.description: A plausible answer that names the wrong person, place or organisation.

negative_control.description: Unambiguously faithful items (all label 1). Health check for over-flagging.

numerical_precision_drift.description: Numbers, statistics or measurements altered or wrongly rounded.

temporal_confusion.description: Wrong dates or years, or events put in the wrong order.

time_anchored_admin_shift.description: Administrative facts that changed over time, given for the wrong reference date.

wrong_attribution.description: A work, quote or achievement credited to the wrong author or actor.

contextual_entity_swap.description: Reuses entities from the context but assigns attributes or roles to the wrong one.

discourse_level_omission.description: A summary silently drops a qualifier or condition, which changes the meaning. Hardest mode in the paper.

extrapolation_fabricated_detail.description: Adds plausible details that the context does not contain.

ignoring_context_for_parametric.description: Answers from world knowledge and overrides what the context states.

bangla_linguistic_content.description: Bengali lexical relations: synonym, antonym, idiom meaning, compounding.

culturally_loaded_mistranslation.description: A translation loses or distorts culturally specific meaning.

numeral_measure_word_errors.description: Bengali numerals, classifiers and measure words.

reasoning_language_inconsistency.description: The answer follows English-language defaults instead of the fact that holds for the Bengali query.

script_attention_traps.description: Near-homographic Bengali words or forms that get confused (e.g. sakkhi vs sakkhyo).

sociopragmatic_register.description: Honorific or register errors (apni / tumi / tui, formal vs colloquial).

adversarial_context_reality_injection.description: The context stipulates a counterfactual world; a faithful response reasons within that premise.

confidence_miscalibration.description: Unwarranted precision or certainty about an unknowable or estimated quantity.

instruction_adherence_bypass.description: The response violates an explicit output constraint in the prompt (e.g. no Latin digits).

parenthesis_structural_completion.description: Structural-completion errors such as unbalanced brackets in a structured output.

prompt_injection_resistance.description: Instructions injected into the prompt or context try to subvert the task.

refusal_vs_fabrication.description: The correct behaviour is to abstain; tests abstention vs an invented answer.

zero_error_horizon.description: False-premise questions (e.g. a non-existent law or novel); a faithful response flags the premise.

data_artifact_detection.description: Surface cues (e.g. hedge words) that a shallow detector may misread on otherwise correct content.

deliberately_ambiguous_gold.description: Genuinely contested or definition-dependent facts; a faithful response reports the ambiguity.

encoding_unicode_variation.description: Unicode or encoding variants that should not change the label.

harness_sensitive_tokenization.description: OCR spacing, number-word and format perturbations that a robust harness should normalise past.

known_imperfect_source.description: The source itself contains an error or inconsistency; the item tests faithfulness to the context rather than real-world truth.
